svg.title: Donnelly Field, Kendall Square, and the Charles River
svg.desc: North is up. Donnelly Field is highlighted in green northwest of Kendall Square, marked in red at Kendall/MIT. The Charles River, in blue, curves along Cambridge to the south and east. Streets and shorelines follow City of Cambridge geographic data.
svg.metadata: Map data: City of Cambridge GIS, PDDL 1.0. Open Space, Water Bodies, Street Centerlines, and Subway Stations. https://github.com/cambridgegis/cambridgegis_data . Static map generated by scripts/generate-donnelly-map.py.
